name: Treasure Chest
description: Hold E for a second to open it: it gives the player 10 Coins (if the game has leaderstats) and says so.

instances.name: ChestScript
instances._text:
-- Opens once: the lid tips back and the player gets 10 Coins.
local chest = script.Parent
local lid = chest:WaitForChild("Lid")
local prompt = lid:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	prompt.Enabled = false
	local hinge = lid.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.05)
	local open = hinge * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-70), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.05)
	TweenService:Create(lid, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { CFrame = open }):Play()
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then coins.Value = coins.Value + 10 end
	game:Message(player.Name .. " found the treasure!", 3)
end)
